messages:
Carlos: Heads-up: got an alert from audit-pipeline — a KMS ImportKey operation from service-account-prod at 11:12 UTC. This account hasn't done KMS ops before.
Anya: Ack. Can you paste the audit entry?
Carlos: Here — log snippet:
```
{ "time": "2026-03-20T11:12:03Z", "actor": "svc-account-prod@redwood", "action": "ImportKey", "target_key": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/rtm-enc", "ip": "18.205.45.12", "user_agent": "gcloud-sdk/344.0" }
```
Carlos: IP geolocates to a cloud-hosted VM we don't own. Not a typical gcloud user action.
DevSecBot: @channel Automated check: service-account-prod has recent permission changes: roles/cloudkms.admin added 22:45 UTC yesterday by user: leo. Suspicious? 
Leo: I made changes to let a short-lived infra job provision keys for patching last week — but that was scoped to staging, not prod. Will check my shell history.
Anya: Good catch. Carlos, can you freeze the key and revoke that import if possible? Also list any buckets/instances that reference that key.
Carlos: Trying to disable key usage now. Command: `gcloud kms keys disable rtm-enc --location=global --keyring=prod` -> permission denied (role required).
Anya: Ok, we need an emergency access block. @Leo — can you escalate your change? Did you use a delegated admin role?
Leo: I approved a terraform change that created a terraform-sa and granted kms.admin to svc-account-prod temporarily. I have the PR link: https://git.internal/infra/changes/2345. It shows intent but seems the binding target is prod.
Sam: I'm going to run a quick scan for recent decrypts using that key. One moment.
Sam: Scan results: 16 decrypt operations in last 3 hours from the same IP and two different service accounts (svc-account-prod, backup-agent). backup-agent hasn't touched that key before.
DevSecBot: Noted: audit log integrity check flagged two truncated log files around 10:58 UTC from audit-collector-1. Might indicate ingestion gaps.
Anya: That increases risk. Action list: (1) create incident channel #incident-kms-1954321000, (2) rotate any plaintext material that could be exposed, (3) revoke temporary roles, (4) preserve logs and snapshot VM for forensics, (5) notify CISO.
Carlos: Created channel and invited SecOps. Snapshotting the source IP VM via infra team now.
Leo: Rolling back the terraform binding and revoking service-account-prod keys. PR: https://git.internal/infra/revert/2345.
Sam: KMS key rtm-enc shows active decrypts as of 11:14; I'm blocking network egress for backup-agent hosts and queuing a vault rotation for secrets that reference rtm-enc.
Carlos: Forensic capture: `gcloud compute instances get-serial-port-output vm-3182` and starting a disk snapshot. Saving to evidence bucket: gs://sec-evidence/1954321000/.
Anya: Good. We need to preserve audit-collector-1 logs before any rotation. @DevSecBot, export current audit log shard and checksum.
DevSecBot: Export initiated: gs://sec-evidence/1954321000/audit-shard-1.log.gz . SHA256: d4c2... (full hash saved to ticket).
Sam: Moving to containment: disabled external IP on vm (18.205.45.12), revoked service-account-prod token, rotated prod service tokens for db-read replicas that used rtm-enc.
Leo: I'm drafting the RCA timeline. Timeline so far: 03-19 22:45 role granted (terraform), 03-20 10:58 audit collector gap, 03-20 11:12 ImportKey and decrypts, 11:20 snapshot & revocation.
Anya: Assignments: Carlos — evidence & VM snapshot (done/in-progress). Sam — secrets rotation and decrypt audit. Leo — config rollback + PR revert. DevSecBot — preservation of logs, indicators, and updating ACL blocklist. I'll take communications and CISO briefing.
Carlos: Handing off to oncall-night (Anya) at 11:45 UTC for next steps and post-incident actions. I'll add notes to the incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-109.
Anya: Received handoff. Next: schedule full incident review and scope any customer-facing disclosure. Also recommend immediate RBAC policy tightening: require approver + 24h delay for kms.admin grants in prod via policy.
Leo: Agree. I'll put a stop-gap OrgPolicy requiring MFA and ticket approval for high-priv grants.
Anya: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread updated with artifacts. :lock:
